name: atelier
description: Build websites that look like a design studio made them: editorial serif typography, warm-neutral and near-black grounds, cinematic photography, layered scroll parallax and exploded technical views. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, a motion runtime, a section library, a scaffolder and an audit that fails on the usual generated-site tells.

interface.shortDescription: Websites that look designed, not generated
interface.longDescription: A pinned art direction plus the code that produces it. Editorial serif typography at real optical sizes, warm-neutral and near-black grounds in OKLCH, cinematic photography with eased scrims, layered scroll parallax, and exploded technical views built from stacked 2D layers rather than a 3D engine. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, a dependency-free motion runtime, a library of section archetypes, a scaffolder, and an audit that fails the build on placeholder copy, missing image dimensions, pure black and white, absent reduced-motion handling, and the other marks of a generated page.
defaultPrompt: Build me a landing page for a roofing company in Houston
Make this page look like it was designed rather than generated
Add a scroll parallax hero to this site
